scope: Additive TH18 Air Sweeper current-source catalogue and partial mechanics record. No directional displacement is materialized without a reproducible blast-curve and collision contract.
game_version: Goblins Farm reports client build 18.600.3; the current Fandom mechanics page does not identify a client build. Supercell's direction-and-cone statement has no build identifier.

sources.title: The Town Hall 17 Update Is Here!
sources.limitations: Confirms that Air Sweeper is an aimed defense for which a player chooses an aim direction and a coverage cone. It does not publish its range, cadence, angle, blast origin, curve, displacement, target selection, collision, interruption or fixed-tick ordering.

sources.title: Air Sweeper | Clash of Clans Wiki | Goblins Farm
sources.version: client build 18.600.3 as reported by publisher
sources.limitations: Reports 2x2 geometry, L1-L7 hitpoints, two available at TH18, air-only/no-damage role, 1-15 range and five-second attack speed. It does not define a numerical cone, blast path, push vector, collision clipping, multi-target order, action interruption or retarget timing.

sources.title: Air Sweeper
sources.limitations: Lists L1-L7 push strengths, 1-15 range, five-second attack speed, air-only/no-damage targeting, a 60-degree 14-tile sector, 3.5-second animation and maximum 1.2-second attack interruption. The page also has historical descriptions with conflicting 90-degree and 120-degree coverage, and defines the push as normal to an unspecified curved blast; it does not publish the curve, origin, precise vector, collision or deterministic ordering.

value.confidence: mixed: primary qualitative direction/cone; build-dated secondary catalogue; version-unknown secondary mechanics

reported_mechanics.push_direction: normal to the reported curved air blast

not_materialized: acquisition versus effect sector and their boundaries
tick-aligned schedule, interruption and retarget order
snapshot/replay state for an unfinished pushed actor

partial_mechanics_contract.note: Values are imported as an explicit data-only contract. The primary direction/cone confirmation and the build-dated secondary catalogue corroborate portions of it, but no shared-Core push model is authorized while the curve/vector and collision rules remain unpublished.

support.note: Air Sweeper remains intentionally unavailable through Core, Headless, Viewer, RL, snapshots and replays because the documented qualitative directional effect cannot be converted to a deterministic movement rule without inventing geometry.

known_uncertainties: The primary source confirms direction and a cone but supplies no numerical geometry. The current version-unknown secondary page reports a 60-degree, 14-tile effect sector while its historical text also reports 90-degree and 120-degree coverage; no current primary or build-pinned record resolves whether these describe targeting, swivel or effect geometry.
No consulted source defines the air-blast curve or origin. Since its own description says a victim moves normal to that curve, a radial or facing-vector substitute would be an invented combat rule.

No consulted source defines effect eligibility at cone/range edges, batch versus sequential target processing, entity-ID ties, wall/collision clipping, target loss, action-lock schedule, retargeting, or interactions with movement, attacks, spells, traps, snapshots and replays.
No source-verified current visual tier, directed blast geometry or animation-to-tick mapping was obtained.
conclusion: Air Sweeper L1-L7 now has a current additive, provenance-complete catalogue/mechanics record. It remains data-only and partial: Core, Headless, Viewer, RL, snapshots and replays deliberately expose no generic pushback proxy until reproducible geometry, movement and ordering evidence exists.
